Libraries for detecting browser/runtime features, user agents, and execution
environments in JavaScript.

* https://uaparser.dev/[uaparser]
* https://github.com/sindresorhus/get-windows[get-windows]

* https://github.com/Modernizr/Modernizr[Modernizr]
